role: new recorded development run; frozen evaluation only, no training
source: byte-exact sealed closeout source, including I02 projection; never substitute the earlier prototype
freeze: this file is written before replay/scoring; no result-based selection or edits
replay: one native engine.process per raw event, same CommunicationBridge and SavedStream and ThermalObserver as recorded runtime; no network clients
state_substitutions: QS, LP30, LP120 reuse frozen formulas. All use the current causal KF E and current TJ/PWM; LP integrates the previous QS on actual dt, seeded from the first QS. These are explicitly current-E diagnostics, not the old fixed-E scores.
state_resets: original native/source/input support only; never workload phase or request boundary
label: first accepted TJ at or after nominal target, within +2s; matching source epoch; source validity independent of fan/context. Each horizon independent; no interpolation
B1: inherited 30s endpoint slope; current valid source sequence, break at >5s/source epoch, minimum 10s support
A_roll: same observed current TJ and causal Ts/E; actual future independent rails and successful PWM within native TTL; no future TJ update; stratify future observed context
B_HOLD: same observed current TJ and causal Ts/E; hold only inputs already available at origin. No future inputs, TJ, workload phase/end or external temperature
A_long: freeze KF state at the first accepted source-valid TJ after 60s from first source-valid TJ; then propagate actual TTL-qualified inputs, no more TJ/state/E updates. Stop at first unsupported physical-input/source interval; no phase reset. Not a thermal equilibrium claim
common_cohort: common origin/horizon/label refs across all five state branches and B0/B1, with SHA; own coverage also reported; KF-vs-conditional pair separately

surface.role: CH1 local fin surface contact, independent diagnostic only; not true Ts, ambient or control input
surface.time_interpretation: 0 preserves raw nominal calendar. -3/-4 conditionally assume the pictured web reference equals the native UTC clock and subtract instrument-minus-web display offsets. These are NOT calibrated bounds, exact sync, or a drift fit; do not select a best offset
surface.reference: one raw CSV row at/after first background start+150s using unshifted UTC+8 nominal calendar, fixed for all scenarios and all branches. Subtract each series value at that same scenario reference time once, no scale/lag/per-stage alignment
surface.comparisons: absolute trajectories and one-reference relative changes; descriptive relative trajectory discrepancy is not Ts error or a physical model ranking
surface.missing: no interpolation or zero fill; previous value only inside original TTL/model support; retain all equal adjacent CSV rows

output: new independent local research directory and minimal independently rerunnable private evidence; do not recursively archive old bundles
